headline: HIJACKER LEAPS FROM JET WITH $200,000
dispatch: A man calling himself D. B. Cooper has disappeared from a Northwest Orient airliner after receiving $200,000 and four parachutes. He released the passengers in Seattle, then left the aircraft by its rear stairs during a night flight south, somewhere over the Pacific Northwest.
answer: D. B. Cooper vanishes from a hijacked airliner, 1971
